PROCUREMENT POLICY
Policy Code: PRC-004
Title: IT Hardware and Software
Version: 1.2
Effective Date: 2025-03-01
Category: it
Company: Northwind Industrial Co.
1. Hardware
1.1 All IT hardware purchases must be reviewed by the IT department before approval.
1.2 Laptops must be selected from the standard configuration catalog unless the IT
    department approves an exception in writing.
1.3 Any single IT hardware item priced above USD 2,000 requires a written technical
    justification.
2. Software
2.1 Software licences must be reviewed by the information security team before purchase.
2.2 Subscription software with an annual cost above USD 10,000 requires a contract
    reviewed by legal.
2.3 Software must be licensed to the company, not to an individual employee.
SYNTHETIC DATA - fictional company and vendors, not a real document
